a11y.apg: No APG pattern: it is a native <textarea>. Enter inserts a line break rather than submitting, which is the difference from Input and the reason both exist. Tab moves out instead of indenting — a text area that traps Tab traps the keyboard.
a11y.keyboardNote: Measured in a browser on 29/08/2026 (apps/keyboard-probe + tests/visual/teclado-motor.spec.ts). This ficha comes from the lineage that did not have check 30, so it declared keys with no measurement behind them — the merge of the two lineages on 29/08/2026 is what surfaced it. Confirmed: Enter, which inserts a line break and changes the value. Tab and Shift+Tab are out of the count on both sides by construction: Tab moves focus anywhere on a page, so it never distinguishes one component from another. What this measurement establishes is that there is no ENGINE keyboard here to measure — the keyboard is the document order, which is the correct answer for this component.

props.name: rows
props.description: Visible height in lines. The user can still resize it; the field does not fight that.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: An example of the content, not the label.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. Every native attribute of the element passes through: name, required, autoComplete, pattern, min/max, and the rest.

props.name: size
props.description: The system's size step, NOT the HTML rows/cols. Height still grows with the content.
